title: First Light Hunt
what_i_found: Twenty animals from two kits (quadruped and bird) stretched by proportion, antler and stance, so the book could actually close. The first playable frame was a bald mint disk with a hunter standing on a ball; sitting the rider and occupying the near meadow moved the picture more than another species. Gallop rumble uses the gamepad actuator when one exists, and a hoof thud plus dust when it does not.
